title: Five levels of eye area
header: HERE IS WHAT FIVE LEVELS OF **EYE AREA** LOOK LIKE

L3_neutral.base: man, age 28, dark short hair, neutral expression, average eye area, dark suit, white shirt, no tie

L1_hunter.edit: eyes only: strong positive canthal tilt, brow bone lower and heavier, almost no upper eyelid visible, slight shadow under the brow

L2_hooded.edit: eyes only: mild positive canthal tilt, hooded upper lids, little eyelid visible

L4_droopy.edit: eyes only: neutral canthal tilt, more upper eyelid visible, brows slightly higher

L5_prey.edit: eyes only: negative canthal tilt with outer corners lower than inner, large exposed upper eyelids, brows raised, light under-eye hollows

beats.vo: Here is what five levels of eye area look like, with hunter eyes at the top.
Hooded eyes still tilt upward, but a heavier upper lid now covers most of the crease.
Neutral is the biggest group, about a third of men, with only a mild upward tilt.
Droopy eyes lose the upward tilt completely, and far more of the upper lid shows.
Prey eyes tilt down at the outer corners, with big exposed lids and brows pulled high.
One study varied brow thickness and eye size to see what makes a face look masculine.
Most men are in the middle and do not know it, so check yours honestly.
Brow bone and lid exposure do most of this, and the middle is where most of you sit.
